objective: Build a planar two-medium refraction diagram with adjustable indices, angle arcs and a calculated transmitted ray.

entities.name: Media boundary
entities.guidance: Use two labeled half-space slabs separated by one flat plane and a removable front cutaway for an uncluttered ray view.

entities.name: Rays and normal
entities.guidance: Draw incident and transmitted segments in a common plane, an explicit normal and angle arcs measured from it; rays are direction guides, not solid rods.

entities.name: Index controls
entities.guidance: Show n1,n2 and the sine-ratio calculation; display the absence of a real transmitted angle rather than clamping invalid arcsin input.

state_contract.model: Positive refractive indices n1,n2; incident angle theta1 in [0,pi/2). Compute s=(n1/n2)*sin(theta1). For s<=1 use theta2=asin(s); for s>1 report no propagating refracted ray in this model.
state_contract.authority: The analytic Snell calculation determines ray directions and angle labels; transparent material rendering does not calculate the educational ray.
actions: Change incident angle below grazing incidence.

invariants: n1*sin(theta1)=n2*sin(theta2) when a propagating refracted ray exists.
At normal incidence the direction is unchanged.
Equal indices produce equal angles; invalid transmitted solutions are never shown as a fabricated ray.
motion_guidance: Rebuild direction geometry from the current calculation after each edit.
Optional traveling dots indicate direction only; they do not claim optical phase, speed or intensity unless separately modeled.
known_limits: No Fresnel intensity, absorption, polarization, diffraction or dispersion unless extended with additional sourced models.
The no-transmitted-ray branch identifies the Snell boundary; a full total-internal-reflection treatment needs a reflection model and its assumptions.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Refraction at an interface obeys n1*sin(theta1)=n2*sin(theta2), with angles measured from the surface normal.
claims.scope: Planar geometrical-optics interface between media with declared refractive indices.

source_refs.locator: 1.3, law of refraction and angles measured from normal
